verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
-Otumalemu mu ffe
Okwegomba kwonna
Okutasaanira;
-Omusana-ogwakaayakana
Omulise-emyoyo gyaffe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
Tuwe-Okwagalana;
Tutuukirizenga
Etteeka lya Yesu:
Twesibenga-obuwombeefu
Tunakuwalire-ebibi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
Otusobozese
Okutuukiriza
Yesu by'ayagala;
Tuyaayaanire Katonda,
Bye yategekera fenna.
